# Strawberry Rain · Inline Metal Shader
Thirty-two red strawberries fall continuously through a pale autumn sky. Each fruit has rounded 3D surface lighting, a glossy highlight, and golden seeds that move across its curved face as it turns. Its leafy crown and stem turn with it: rear leaves pass behind the berry and front leaves overlap it. The berries also tumble and drift side to side. The shader is embedded in the Text node and needs no external texture or shader file. JSON State advances time by 1/60 second per Loop call; Loop is capped at 60 Hz. Width and Height control full-screen preview and saved output.
